Prompts

```
['build a Mask2FormerHead instance with pixel decoder, transformer decoder, and loss configs for universal image segmentation', 'run the Mask2FormerHead forward pass on multi-scale features to get classification and mask predictions per decoder layer', 'compute classification, mask, and dice losses for all decoder layers using ground truth labels and masks', 'run inference with Mask2FormerHead to produce predicted semantic segmentation logits from multi-level features', 'compute classification and mask targets for all images using point sampling and assigner for a decoder layer']
```

